prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering friction (moving sign-in after pet selection), adding a pet control tutorial screen, and estimated countdown wait info won.
Bypassing onboarding steps (new_flow) yielded mixed results, winning in one test but significantly hurting in another.
Major redesigns and sign-in safety hints significantly hurt performance.
Copy updates, permission checks, layout changes, and notifications showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated actual gains, but underestimated performance for the tutorial screen and countdown info.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +7.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -12.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -0.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +7.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.6%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop pet interaction playground on wait screen: Adds an interactive mini-game screen during generation wait time where users can practice petting and feeding a test companion on their desktop. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s) causing significant drop-off before finishing onboarding.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet shortcut and wake controls guide screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding tutorial screen explaining mouse actions, tray icon controls, and summon shortcuts before completing setup. (why: 3 support tickets reported users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing setup, hurting finish completion (71.6%).)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided photo tips sub-flow for pet generation: Inserts a photo guidance screen before photo upload detailing optimal lighting and framing for custom pet generation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results, contributing to drop-off in the adoption step (69.3%).)
3: [sign_in, layout] Split view layout for sign-in screen: Redesigns sign_in into a split-column layout featuring pet save safety perks next to login options. (why: 8 support emails noted pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating confusion over account data syncing.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] Generation photo tip carousel during upload: Adds an interactive tip carousel to the upload screen showing examples of photo angles while processing. (why: Median adoption time is high at 89s and pet generation issues generated multiple support tickets.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop readiness audio chime notification: Plays a soft audio notification chime on the waiting screen when the pet finish state is ready. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s, causing users to minimize or switch away from the desktop pet app.)
6: [finish, hint] System tray icon positioning hint on home intro: Displays an explicit hint on home_intro showing where the pet lives in the system tray when hidden. (why: 3 support emails reported users unable to find, control, or unhide their pet after setup, leading to drop-off in finish step (71.6%).)
7: [choose_path, copy] Personality-driven path choice headlines: Updates path selection headline and body copy to focus on pet companion personality styles instead of technical creation paths. (why: Mean time on choose_path is high (514s); clear personality-driven copy helps decision velocity.)
8: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud pet backup highlight on sign-in: Adds a cloud sync status badge and hint to the sign-in screen reinforcing pet save state protection. (why: 8 support tickets complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)

scores.note: Addresses high wait time at home, but building a mini-game screen has high implementation cost and unproven mechanics.
